method_boundaries.independent_Heston_Delta: own lognormal truncated first moment formula checked against saved f-xfx
method_boundaries.local: saved CRN finite bumps only; stock-dependent field forbids homogeneous derivative substitution
method_boundaries.variance: fixed selected call derivatives; denominator uncertainty separate and unmeasured
method_boundaries.beta: fixed1; no beta optimization; DESIGN7.3 excludes optimization in v1
method_boundaries.production_operator: production tensor cubic has its own state/threshold interpolation errors; direct sample derivative does not certify it
